answer: To resist sybils, gate each new agent behind a small proof-of-work tied to a rotating challenge seed and a staked bond; forging many identities then costs real compute plus locked capital per persona, making farming uneconomical before the horizon of the next epoch. A zephyr of random seeds sweeps stale identities, and any umber of duplicate registrations collapses into one when the bond is slashed, so attackers pay repeatedly while honest agents pay once. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
